update.title: Job 40:13 citation removed from 13.1 and 10.14 (#2158)
update.researcher_instruction: "2158, I looked at the verse Job 40:13 - it has no relevance. remove the citation,  and if not supported by other verses, remove the claim also in the narrative." (2026-10-15)
update.method: The ranges Job 40:10-14 (13.1 Majesty) and Job 40:11-14 (10.14 The proud brought low) restated as 40:10-12, 14 and 40:11-12, 14; the quoted words are from those verses. The Job 40:13 source rows of C-239 and C-181 removed by direct edit (no register action removes a source row, #2146) and their written ranges restated. Both claims keep their other sources (C-239: Psa 93:1-2, Exo 15:1, 7, Deu 33:26, Psa 68:34-35, Isa 2:10-11, Job 40:10-12, 14; C-181: its other sources and Job 40:11-12, 14), so neither is removed.
update.claims_changed_note: C-239 and C-181: Job 40:13 source removed; claims kept (supported by other verses)
update.notes: Applies the researcher's ruling on Job 40:13 to both citations of it, including 10.14 / C-181, earlier closed as by-design under #2151.
